name: NgTBSpecimenShipmentRegister
title: NG TB Specimen Shipment Register
description:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 03 Specimen Shipment Form, Version 2, 2019. One model
instance represents one specimen shipment from a facility or treatment unit
to a laboratory and contains repeatable specimen entries together with
shipping, receipt, transport-condition and acknowledgement information.

mapping.name: NG TB Specimen Shipment Register Column Mapping

Maps NgTBSpecimenShipmentRegister logical-model elements to the
NTBLCP/TB 03 Specimen Shipment Form, Version 2, 2019.

element.definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 03 Specimen Shipment Form, Version 2, 2019. One model
instance represents one specimen shipment from a facility or treatment unit
to a laboratory and contains repeatable specimen entries together with
shipping, receipt, transport-condition and acknowledgement information.
Identifier assigned to the specimen shipment or its electronic equivalent.
Date the specimen consignment was shipped to the receiving laboratory.
Reference to the facility or treatment unit sending the specimens, when available.

element.short: Name of facility or treatment unit
element.definition: Name of the facility or treatment unit from which the specimens are shipped.
State in which the originating facility or treatment unit is located.
Local Government Area in which the originating facility or treatment unit is located.
Reference to the laboratory processing the specimens, when available.
Name of the laboratory to which the specimen shipment is sent.
One patient/specimen included in the shipment.
